headline: Edelweiss MF CEO Radhika Gupta advises 10-15% international portfolio allocation

modes.bear: Overexposure to global markets adds currency risk and higher management costs for Indian investors.
modes.bull: International exposure protects your portfolio from domestic market downturns and grants access to global giants.
modes.simple: Think of Indian stocks as your main daily meal and global stocks as a fun treat. Experts suggest keeping 10 to 15 percent of your money in global markets to stay safe and try new opportunities.

summary: Edelweiss Mutual Fund CEO Radhika Gupta recommends that Indian investors keep domestic equities as their portfolio core while allocating 10 to 15 percent to international investments. She compares Indian equities to staple food and global investments to diverse cuisines. This strategy aims to diversify risks and access opportunities across different geographies. Indian retail investors looking to reduce home-country bias can consider this allocation guideline for their long-term portfolios.
why_it_matters: Guides Indian investors on ideal global portfolio diversification limits.
